---
name: Security report
about: Read this before reporting a security problem
labels: security
---

**Do not describe a vulnerability in this issue.** Issues are public.

Report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting instead:
https://github.com/cameri/nostream/security/advisories/new

`SECURITY.md` lists the versions that receive security fixes and what to include in a report.

Use this template only for a security question or a hardening suggestion that exposes nothing an attacker could use.
